caption:
Many of the best routes for mountain biking in Costa Rica aren't built for sport; they are old farm tracks carved into the clay hillsides. Over time, the canopy closes overhead, leaving a narrow, double-track corridor where the dirt stays damp and the traction is a constant negotiation. Riding here requires a different kind of focus—you learn to read the changing color of the clay and trust the line the forest leaves behind. It is slow, demanding work, but the reward is a quiet that tarmac never knows.
